where_to_adjust.title: Rushing yards: the projection is less accurate than the Vegas line
where_to_adjust.finding: Average error is 21.8% worse than the line in every season (2024: 22.36 vs 17.83, 2025: 21.09 vs 17.83). Blending toward the line at a 5% model weight cut the average error from 21.73 to 17.84 in out-of-sample tests, against 17.83 for the line alone.
where_to_adjust.suggestion: Show the calibrated projection (line + 5% × (raw − line)) next to the raw one. The blend only matches the line, so do not present large raw-versus-line gaps as high-confidence edges.

where_to_adjust.finding: Over picks hit 49.1% over 8559 picks (95% range 48.0–50.1%), below the 52.4% needed at -110, and below it in every season (2024: 49.4%, 2025: 48.8%).
where_to_adjust.suggestion: Treat every over pick with extra skepticism: raise the bar for surfacing one, or require support from a second signal.

where_to_adjust.title: Rushing yards unders: above break-even in every season
where_to_adjust.finding: 55.8% over 1013 picks (95% range 52.7–58.8%). Betting every under with no model at all hits 53.9%, so the model adds about +1.9 points.
where_to_adjust.suggestion: Keep surfacing these picks. Most of the result is the market, not the model.

where_to_adjust.title: Passing TDs: a blend with the line beats the line itself
where_to_adjust.finding: At a 50% model weight the blended projection beat the line in every out-of-sample test (average error 0.966 against 0.980).
where_to_adjust.suggestion: Use a 50% model weight for the calibrated projection.

where_to_adjust.title: Tier ranking holds for over picks in 2025
where_to_adjust.finding: Using 2024 cutoffs, over picks in 2025 hit ELITE 56.3% down to SKIP 43.6%: the model ranks them well.
where_to_adjust.suggestion: Keep the percentile tiers; they separate the better picks from the weaker ones.

where_to_adjust.title: Under picks: the seasons disagree
where_to_adjust.finding: Under picks cleared break-even in some seasons and not others (2024: 51.0%, 2025: 55.2%).
where_to_adjust.suggestion: Do not act on this side until more weeks are in.

where_to_adjust.title: Tier ranking does not hold for under picks in 2025
where_to_adjust.finding: Using 2024 cutoffs, under picks in 2025 hit ELITE 55.7% / STRONG 57.5% / MED 54.5% / LEAN 55.4% / SKIP 53.5%: the order is not clean.
where_to_adjust.suggestion: Do not treat a higher tier as more reliable for under picks until this ranks cleanly.

notes: Recommendations only: this review never changes the model.
Every weight and cutoff here was tuned on one season and tested on the other, in both directions. Two seasons is a small sample.
Both seasons have now been looked at many times, so they are development data. The clean test is live picks frozen before kickoff.
The hit-rate tables use -110 as the price; real prices are not stored in the archives yet.
